{{Quote|Lou! Are you crazy? Pointing that thing at a Jedi? Put it down now!|A [[Spaceport police droid/Legends|spaceport police droid]] to Loubo, as he's holding a frying pan at the ready|<ref name="Brothers">{{TCW|Brothers (episode)}}</ref>}}
'''Loubo''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] who was the owner of [[Plop Dribble's/Legends|Plop Dribble's]], a [[Spaceport/Legends|spaceport]] restaurant on [[Stobar/Legends|Stobar]]. He was a member of a [[Unidentified tentacle-faced species/Legends|tentacle-faced species]].

==Biography==
In [[20 BBY/Legends|20 BBY]], [[Savage Opress/Legends|Savage Opress]] stopped on [[Stobar/Legends|Stobar]] on his way to find his [[Darth Maul/Legends|brother]]. When he started to choke a waitress named [[Sassi/Legends|Sassi]], Loubo yelled for his [[WA-7 waitress droid/Legends|WA-7 service unit]], [[Marwigo/Legends|Marwigo]], to alert [[Spaceport police droid/Legends|the authorities]]. They did not get there in time; Opress had escaped, but they were able to save Sassi.

When [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] and his [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] [[Ahsoka Tano/Legends|Ahsoka Tano]] arrived at the diner, Loubo, justifiably fearing for the life of his staff from the earlier event, tried to defend his diner with a frying pan, although the security droids talked him out of it, citing that it's a useless weapon against a Jedi. After the misunderstanding was resolved, he offered them meals "on the house," as compensation.

==Personality and traits==
Loubo had a [[Tattoo/Legends|tattoo]] of a [[Heart/Legends|heart]] on his arm with text on it. In [[Aurebesh/Legends|Aurebesh]], it reads as "MOM". He also pulled a [[Frying pan/Legends|frying pan]] out to defend himself and Sassi from [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] Anakin Skywalker, but was asked to stop by a police [[Droid/Legends|droid]]. He then later offered him and his Padawan Ahsoka Tano some food "on the house". The event involving Savage appeared to really scare him and his staff.

==Behind the scenes==
Loubo, in the infamous scene where he pulled a frying pan on Skywalker, was originally intended to pull a blaster on him, but it was changed for unknown reasons. [[Pablo Hidalgo]], the person who maintains the Trivia galleries for the various episodes, commented that the change turned the scene into a joke.
